paras: Our Formula 1 heritage is evident in our swan neck wing. Its compositional design is 45% lighter than aluminium, while the upright engineering maximizes aerodynamic efficiency and minimizes air resistance.
ADRO's Toyota A90 Supra AT-R2 Swan Neck Wing is crafted from prepreg carbon fibre offers over 250 pounds of downforce at 110 mph, making sure weight savings are at their peak.
